item.title: Dow futures fall 300 points to start shortened week as oil prices climb: Live updates

item.description: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.

item.title: Pharma major Novartis falls nearly 10%, heading for worst day on record after three drug trial setbacks
item.description: Shares of Novartis tanked on Tuesday after results from its del-desiran drug trial disappointed investors.

item.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks
item.description: More than 60% of cryptocurrency platforms that lost money due to cyberattacks had undergone independent security audits, CoinGecko said.

item.title: Cholesterol drug setback casts doubt over multibillion-dollar race

item.description: Mistral is betting on open-weight AI models to help it compete with players like OpenAI and Anthropic.

item.title: Global shipping authorities warn of maritime trade breakdown amid geopolitical turmoil

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: China's weak consumer becomes the world's problem

item.title: Inside Italy’s banking M&A boom — and why Wall Street is watching
item.description: Italy has become the center of Europe’s banking consolidation boom, with a wave of takeover bids reshaping the country’s financial sector. This video explains what is driving the dealmaking, how battles for influence over banks including Monte dei Paschi and Mediobanca connect to insurer Generali, and why the outcome could have implications for Europe’s push to build larger banks capable of competing with U.S. rivals.

item.title: 'Ah! Rejected, yet again': How this 45-year-old turned his 'demoralizing' job search into a one-man show
